d:
Nepal’s Prime Minister Balen Shah has arrived in India on his first bilateral foreign visit. This visit is scheduled for two days. Upon reaching New Delhi, Prime Minister Balen Shah met with Prime Minister Modi. A bilateral meeting between the two leaders took place at Hyderabad House. Let us examine what transpired during this meeting and what the significance of the Nepalese Prime Minister’s visit is.
